briefings.title: QIA, Apollo & Goldman CEOs on Global Capital
briefings.tldr: Global capital allocators emphasize that deploying capital successfully requires looking past daily noise to focus on 5-to-20-year trends, navigating an unprecedented technology supercycle, and managing structural shifts across energy, infrastructure, and geopolitical fragmentation.

briefings.title: Private Markets and The Future of Capital Allocation with Marc Rowan | The a16z Show

people.name: Marc Rowan
people.role: Cofounder, CEO, and Chair of Apollo Global Management

briefings.tldr: As public markets face extreme concentration, Apollo Global Management is scaling past $1 trillion in assets by shifting from traditional private equity to investment-grade private credit—bridging long-term retirement liabilities with the massive, capital-intensive infrastructure demands of AI, energy, and robotics.

briefings.title: Apollo's Rowan Puts Current Credit Cycle Into Context
briefings.tldr: Apollo is pivoting from its "buccaneering" roots toward investment-grade private credit to fund a "global industrial renaissance," arguing that moving credit risk from bank balance sheets to private investors has made the global financial system more resilient.
